articles.title: Indian Army JCO killed in firing in J&K's Samba district
articles.summary: An Army Junior Commissioned Officer (JCO) tragically died in a firing incident within a military camp in Samba district, Jammu and Kashmir, late Tuesday. Army officials confirmed the incident, which occurred inside a secure military facility. An investigation into the circumstances surrounding the JCO's death is currently underway, as authorities review the details of this unfortunate event.

articles.title: Thailand-Cambodia resume border peace talks once more
articles.summary: Thailand and Cambodia have resumed crucial talks this Wednesday, focusing on securing a durable ceasefire after recent renewed fighting erupted along their shared border. Senior military officials from both nations are engaging in discussions to de-escalate tensions and establish lasting peace in the disputed region, a development important for regional stability.

articles.title: What are the Yankees doing? Reviewing Bronx Bombers' mild winter
articles.summary: The New York Yankees disappointed fans this holiday season by failing to make any major new player signings. Their primary objective remains re-signing star free agent Cody Bellinger. This lack of significant roster upgrades highlights a cautious off-season approach, leaving the eager fan base awaiting substantial team improvements.

articles.title: Vaishnaw thanks Rahul Gandhi for 'acknowledging success' of 'Make in India'
articles.summary: Rahul Gandhi praised job creation at Foxconn's Karnataka unit, crediting the state's Congress government for fostering a robust manufacturing ecosystem. He emphasized the significant employment opportunities generated, showcasing a model for industrial growth. This highlights the impact of state policies in attracting investment and boosting national economic development through job creation initiatives.
